title: Baby Reclining in Bouncer by Sunny Window, 1971 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic black-and-white family snapshot captured in May 1971, featuring a wide-eyed baby dressed in a soft fleece sleeper resting comfortably in a vintage infant bouncer chair. The baby is positioned beside a sunlit window sill on top of a patterned blanket, bathed in natural light.
